content.what_it_is: TRACKING-conditional Fortran module TRACER (L54-L579) implementing Lagrangian point tracking. TRACER_INITIAL (L93-L176) reads a tracker file containing a header, tracker count, output interval, and per-tracker x/y/start-time/layer rows; allocates coordinate, triangle/barycentric-state, velocity, and search arrays; initializes search flags; locates initial cells; and resets the output counter. GET_XY_POSITION (L178-L371) searches two triangles per structured cell using signed subtriangle areas, caches triangle vertex indices and areas, retries a full-domain search after a local search fails, and in parallel all-reduces ownership. TRACK_XY (L373-L414) snapshots state, advects, broadcasts owner coordinates in parallel, relocates cells, and rolls back a move judged dry. BROADCAST_XY (L418-L502) gathers each rank's coordinates and IN_CELL flags to rank zero, chooses coordinates from flagged ranks, and scatters coordinates back. MOVE_TRACER (L505-L546) barycentrically interpolates surface, bottom, or depth-averaged velocity and advances x/y explicitly by DT. OUTPUT_TRACKING (L548-L575) constructs a dynamic format once and appends time plus all tracker x/y coordinates to tk_x.txt and tk_y.txt on rank zero.

verbatim_spans.text: !  VESSEL is a module to model ship-wakes

unresolved: Copy/paste logic defect: the rollback dryness test at L397 sums MASK at vertex 1 and vertex 2 twice, omitting the separately stored vertex 3 (nx3,ny3 restored at L402-L403 and used by interpolation at L515/L519 and subsequent layer branches). A dry/wet state unique to vertex 3 cannot affect rollback.

MPI use-before-assignment defect: X_TRACK_ALL, Y_TRACK_ALL, and IN_CELL_ALL are populated only inside myid==0 blocks at L442-L466, but the selection loop at L470-L477 is outside any root guard and reads these automatic local arrays on every rank. Non-root ranks therefore branch on and copy uninitialized gathered arrays before the later scatter overwrites coordinates.

MPI range/interface assumption: gather buffers are dimensioned NumberProcessor at L421-L426, while copy/fill/selection loops use px*py at L443, L453, L463, L471, L485, and L493. No local invariant establishes px*py==NumberProcessor; mismatch permits buffer overrun or leaves gathered ranks unexamined.

Ineffective singularity guard: MOVE_TRACER rejects only exact Sc(I)==0.0 at L509, then divides weighted velocities by Sc(I) at L516, L520, L525, L529, L534, and L538. Near-degenerate triangles with very small nonzero area pass the check and can create unbounded tracer velocities; no SMALL/tolerance test is used.
Copy/paste metadata defect: L46 describes VESSEL and ship wakes, but the implemented module is TRACER at L54 and contains only particle tracking procedures.

Input range gap: NumTracker is read without validation at L122 and immediately controls allocations at L125-L164 and loop bounds; malformed, zero, or negative counts and short per-tracker input are not checked locally.
